title: Topaz Collection: Shimmer Lip Gloss & Liquid Highlighter Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Vegan✓ Shimmer Finish✓ High Shine Finish✓ Liquid Formula✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A two piece set of full size universal Topaz Gloss Highlighter and Shimmer Lip Gloss for a soft, golden summer glow.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Avocado Oil (Gloss Highlighter): Rich in vitamins to nourish.

- Hyaluronic Acid (Lip Gloss): Works to attract and retain moisture to give the appearance of fuller lips.

- Jojoba Oil (Lip Gloss): Provides lightweight, lasting moisture to the lips.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Highlight: Dab the Topaz Gloss Highlighter onto cheeks and eyelids using fingers or a brush.
-Blend: Tap gently to blend into skin for a soft, radiant finish.
-Shine: Apply the Shimmer Lip Gloss to bare lips or over color for a golden, high-shine glow.
Ingredients+
Gloss Highlighter in Topaz:
-Avocado Oil: Rich in vitamins to nourish.

Hydrogenated Polydecene, Propylene Glycol Dibenzoate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Paraffinum Liquidum, Isohexadecane, Styrene-Ethylene/Propylene-(Styrene), Synthetic Wax, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Cetyl PEG/PPG-10/1 Dimethicone, Phenoxyethanol, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Linum Usitatissimum (Linseed) Seed Oil, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Mica (CI 77019), Iron Oxide (CI 77491), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891)].

Shimmer Lip Gloss in Topaz:
-Hyaluronic Acid: Works to attract and retain moisture to give the appearance of fuller lips.
-Jojoba Oil: Provides lightweight, lasting moisture to the lips.

Polyisobutene, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Octyldodecanol, Cera Microcristallina (Microcrystalline Wax), Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Phenoxyethanol, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Diisostearyl Malate, Caprylyl Glycol, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Behenate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tin Oxide, Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77492).
